verdict.rationale: pnpm is a self-contained executable that runs entirely on the user's own machines and CI with no vendor-hosted service (pnpm-docs-21). It can install offline from the local content-addressable store (pnpm-docs-10, pnpm-docs-15), and its source is published on GitHub (pnpm-gh-1), so the core product is inherently self-run. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, documentation of fully air-gapped installation or distribution of the binary, and independent corroboration of self-hosted use.
